build.title: Widget asset category + search bar (Fable rebuild)

said.text: Widgets ("widget": true: clock, search-bar) attach to banners and toolbars through one host engine (engines/widgets.ts = Kotlin WidgetEngine.kt, fixtures widgets.json): banner.attach and toolbar.widgets (start/end), rt.attachToToolbar/detachFromToolbar/toolbarWidgets on both ports. search-bar asset type (placeholder, maxResults, width, kinds, shortcut) sits in the banner center and searches the whole console: views, settings, actions, assets, windows, dialogs, page words, plan features, tracker items, pending builds, plugins (console providers in consoleSearch.ts). Rebuild with an Android Compose banner + toolbar widgets + search UI. Builds on banner-assets.
